summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (or reuses a system Bun) and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D,'math_init.js')])` against a bundled sibling file. math_init.js is a single-line, ~727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle with a rotated string-array, hex-renamed identifiers, and an alphabet-mapping decoder; its behavior is not statically recoverable. The package is advertised as a Jest configuration preset, which has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime at install and execute an opaque bundle under it. The execution channel (dropped alternate runtime running an obfuscated sibling) is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape and bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. Fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
